title: Gold artifact generation bypassed validated resource discovery

reproduction.setup: Create a symlinked category under resources/ that points to an external directory containing resource/index.tsx with a unique probe string.
reproduction.catalogue: buildCatalogueFromDirectory accepted 324 real resources and excluded the symlinked category.
reproduction.beforeFix: discoverAllComponents independently scanned the resources tree, followed the category link, and returned the external component source.
reproduction.afterFix: discoverAllComponents consumes the validated catalogue directory map; the external probe is absent.

rootCause: Gold artifact generation performed a second filesystem walk and bypassed canonical catalogue discovery.
remediation: Pass the validated manifest-to-directory map into artifact generation. Direct generation first builds the catalogue; every resource root and source file is canonically contained and source reads are capped at 1 MiB.

verification.redBeforeFix: tests/security/gold-artifacts.test.ts failed because the external probe was present in generated components.
verification.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/security/gold-artifacts.test.ts -t "uses only resources admitted by canonical catalogue validation"
